_comment: Prompt-iteration samples for the Produce AI grader. Each case gives the segment context and a student attempt with the score range a human grader would accept. Run with: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=... GRADING_LIVE=1 go test ./src/pkg/models/ -run TestGradeProduceLive -v. Add real student answers here as they come in; the ranges are the rubric.
